title: Passiflora incarnata essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Passiflora incarnata essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowers of the passionflower plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its calming and sedative properties. This oil is often employed to help alleviate anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. It can be applied topically or used in diffusers to create a soothing atmosphere. In traditional herbal practices, it is valued for its ability to support emotional balance and reduce stress.
